paragraphs.text: His great riches gotten in Egypt, did not hinder him in following his vocation.
paragraphs.label: a
paragraphs.anchor: Abram went up out of Egypt

paragraphs.text: He calls the place by the name which was later given to it, Ge 23:19.
paragraphs.label: b

paragraphs.text: This inconvenience came by their riches, which break friendships and the bounds of nature.
paragraphs.label: c

paragraphs.text: Who seeing their contention, might blaspheme God and destroy them.
paragraphs.label: d
paragraphs.anchor: Canaanite and the Perizzite dwelled then

paragraphs.text: He cuts off the opportunity for contention: therefore the evil ceases.
paragraphs.label: e

paragraphs.text: Abram resigns his own right to buy peace.
paragraphs.label: f

paragraphs.text: This was done by God's providence, that only Abram and his seed might dwell in the land of Canaan.
paragraphs.label: h

paragraphs.text: Lot thinking to get paradise, found hell.
paragraphs.label: i

paragraphs.text: The Lord comforted him, lest he should have taken thought for the departure of his nephew.
paragraphs.label: k

paragraphs.text: Meaning a long time, and till the coming of Christ as in Ex 12:14,21:6, De 15:17 and spiritually this refers to the true children of Abram born according to the promise, and not according to the flesh, which are heirs of the true land of Canaan.
paragraphs.label: l
